The number of people downloading the Pronti app skyrocketed after the viral TikTok video.

fact_previews: Pronti is an outfit maker that aims to aid users in getting ready faster and buying smarter.
It takes a person approximately 17 minutes each day to choose their outfit.
This time spent choosing outfits amounts to more than 4 whole days every year.
Pronti's AI technology learns from user interactions, including photos of clothes and style preferences.
Users can upload photos of their clothes to their virtual closet using the app.

fact_previews: Pronti is an app that automatically creates stylized outfits from users' clothes.
The app takes into consideration the weather, user mood, and occasion to provide outfit recommendations.
Pronti has stretch goals that include features such as sharing outfits with friends and connecting the closet to retailers.
The feature to share outfits with friends aims to make getting ready more social.
The 'Buying Smarter' feature is currently in beta and aims to make online shopping more personal.

Pronti was released as a beta product in April and July 2021.
An improved UI/UX design for Pronti was implemented in September 2021.
A major technology improvement, including the image cropper, was made in November 2021.
In December 2021, a TikTok video related to Pronti gained 3 million views, leading to app crashes.
